actions.label: Post Copilot-key mapping guidance

comment.body: PowerToys can handle this through **Remap a shortcut**, not **Remap a key**, because the Copilot hardware key is emitted as `Win + Shift + F23`. In the shortcut editor, use the capture/select control and press the Copilot key so that full chord appears, then map it to the `Apps/Menu` key (the traditional context-menu key). If the context menu still opens in the wrong location or behaves differently from a hardware menu key, that existing PowerToys behavior is tracked in #45168; please add the device/application details there rather than relying on a separate third-party utility.
